observations.description: Qualitative observations about the candidates. No verdicts — only feedback.

candidate_index.description: 0-based index of the candidate from the proposer's candidates array.

observation_type.description: Type of observation: grounding, coverage, abstraction, tension_vs_theme, supporting_evidence.

detail.description: Specific observation. What did you notice? Cite evidence.

is_strong.description: true if this candidate has strong empirical grounding in the data.

suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions for the researcher. What to consider when choosing.
